mentions.name: The citadel of Parana Qila
mentions.passage: The citadel of Parana Qila is an irregular oblong in plan.

mentions.name: The northernmost wicket on the eastern side
mentions.passage:
The northernmost wicket on
the eastern side lies some 496 feet from the N. E. corner of the citadel, its outer
entrance being on the low-level ground outside the walls.

spatialClue.anchorName: N. E. corner of the citadel

mentions.name: third wicket
mentions.passage:
Some 710 feet south
of this again and some 248 feet north of the S. E. corner of the citadel is a third
wicket, the upper portion of which has unfortunately disappeared.

spatialClue.anchorName: S. E. corner of the citadel
